BULLETIN - IMMEDIATE BROADCAST REQUESTED
Flood Warning
National Weather Service Seattle WA
936 AM PST Tue Dec 9 2025

...Forecast flooding changed from Minor to Moderate severity for the 
following rivers in Washington...

  Green River Near Auburn affecting King County.

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood 
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive 
cars through flooded areas.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued by this afternoon at 545 PM PST.

/AUBW1.2.ER.251209T1446Z.251210T0000Z.000000T0000Z.NO/
936 AM PST Tue Dec 9 2025

...FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE...

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is 
  forecast.

* WHERE...Green River near Auburn.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12,000.0 cfs, the Green River will inundate low areas 
  from the middle Green River valley downstream to Auburn...with  
  water over several roads including SE Green Valley Rd and West 
  Valley Rd.  Levees from Auburn down through Tukwilla may exhibit 
  seeapage and may weaken due to saturation.  A flow of 12000 cfs on 
  the Green River corresponds to a phase 4 flood in the King County 
  flood system.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
  - At 8:45 AM PST Tuesday the flow was 9,820.0 cfs.
  - Flood flow is 9,000.0 cfs.
  - Recent Activity...The maximum river flow in the 24 hours
    ending at 8:45 AM PST Tuesday was 9,820.0 cfs.
  - Forecast...The river will rise to 12,828.6 cfs late this
    afternoon. It will then fall late tomorrow morning. It will
    rise to 12,118.1 cfs late Thursday evening. It will then fall
    again but remain above flood stage.
  - Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of
    12,800.0 cfs on 12/29/1945.
  - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
